_comment: Dynamic project configuration read by org_policy/project_resource.tf (copied unmodified from the Sample_Standard_Demos template). Reconcile the key names below against the template's project_config.json before raising the PR; the values are what this demo needs.

org_policies.reason: Cloud Run's built-in Identity-Aware Proxy requires the service to accept all ingress; access is gated by IAP (roles/iap.httpsResourceAccessor for the deploying user), not by network. The constraint is evaluated only when the service is created or updated, so it can be restored once the deployment finishes.

notes: No VM, no public IP, no VPC peering, no service-account key: nothing here conflicts with the Argolis default policies (compute.vmExternalIpAccess, compute.restrictVpcPeering, iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation, sql.restrictPublicIp).
Both stores are Private Service Connect endpoints inside the demo's own subnet; Cloud SQL has ipv4_enabled=false and Memorystore has no public endpoint.
IAP admits user:<gcp_account_name> only; iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains is satisfied because that account belongs to the Argolis organisation.
